title: Preventing Gallstones
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to preventing gallstones.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for major risk factors and protective lifestyle factors; moderate evidence on effectiveness of pharmacologic prevention in selective cases. Emerging evidence on microbial influences on gallstone pathogenesis. Screening recommendations based primarily on expert consensus.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
